question: Cheating in this game covers all three kinds — academic, romantic and election misconduct — and not one of them. That is lamontae's own answer, given 2026-09-22 16:17:33Z in these words: "cheating can mean any of those." So: unblock the content C26 held behind this question, with all three in scope. What does each of the three need in order to exist — what act makes it happen, who can observe it, what follows from being caught and from not being caught, and what should never follow? They share a word and very little else: an exam, a marriage and a ballot have different witnesses, different proof and different consequences, so an answer that collapses them back into one mechanism is not an answer to this.

title: Cheating means all three kinds, and each needs its own mechanism
usableAnswer: Per kind — academic, romantic, election — the act that constitutes it, who can witness or discover it, what follows on discovery and what follows if it is never discovered, and one thing that must never follow. A kind he should not have yet is an equally good answer, as long as it says so rather than quietly folding into another.
whyItMatters: Content is sitting blocked behind a question that now has an answer, which is the cheapest kind of stuck there is. It also touches a standing constraint of his: a person's conduct is supposed to drive their relationships and what others make of them, so cheating is one of the few acts that ought to move several systems at once — and today it moves none of them.

answer.summary:
Academic cheating: a particular represented assessment or submission breaches its applicable academic rules. An assessor, participant or evidence can expose it; an institution then applies its actual process and disposition. If undiscovered, any recorded result remains a result, but competence/knowledge is not magically created. No requirement to make the player perform routine homework or a how-to cheating minigame.

Romantic infidelity: conduct breaches the relationship's actual agreement, not merely the existence of another friend or a universal marriage flag. Discovery follows witnesses, disclosure or available evidence. Partners may disagree, end or attempt repair; no automatic breakup, omniscient partner, violence or universal reputation penalty. Consent and relationship terms remain specific to the people. This fits broader relationship scope but is not made a prerequisite for the current friendship/career milestone.

Election misconduct: record an abstract prohibited act by a responsible actor under the contest's rules, its evidence and any legitimate inquiry/remedy. Do not supply real-world methods, vulnerabilities or concealment instructions. Suspicion is not guilt; wrongdoing does not automatically reverse an election without the supported adjudication and result-correction route. If unobserved, actors without knowledge do not punish it; actual affected records/resources still follow the underlying act. Use existing history, evidence, press and institutional powers rather than a single 'cheating score'.

All three separate underlying act, belief about it, allegation, investigation and consequences. An unsuccessful attempt and a successful act differ. A label never becomes proof, and a character trait alone never declares someone guilty.

Acceptance ChatGPT requests (not executed): For each kind, contrast observed/unobserved and substantiated/unsubstantiated cases. Private consequences do not become universal public knowledge. Same episode cannot apply a penalty once per reader.
